propositions: The dc_store_copy_repo fixture calls git fetch/archive/ls-tree with capture_output=True and check=True, causing CalledProcessError to report only exit status 128 while git's stderr diagnostic message is discarded.
When git fetch origin tickets fails on the live CI run, the root cause (auth, missing ref, network error) is undiagnosable because the captured stderr is lost from the exception.
The fetch is a single un-retried network call on the critical path of a 41-minute live job, so transient failures cause ERROR rather than graceful retry.
Git fetch, archive, and ls-tree calls must be routed through a _run_git helper that raises RuntimeError carrying the command, exit status, and git's verbatim stderr on failure.
The fetch operation must implement bounded retry with backoff before final failure, retrying transients while still failing hard on genuine misconfiguration.
